notes.title: Minor update for Windows
notes.content:
We pushed a minor update last month (July 2025) that caused some confusion due to the lack of patch notes. 



This update just fixed a long standing issue introduced in a previous update, which caused the game to lose focus and minimize during the opening cutscene in Windows 10. Hopefully this should no longer happen.  We also used this as a chance to update the controller database to support some newer controllers. 



Apologies for any confusion caused by the lack of patch notes, I'd assumed it was a small enough update to not really require a note, till I saw folks react in the forum.  Will be sure to include patch notes for any basic maintenance updates like this in the future!  ːtbphappyː

notes.title: MAC OS CATALINA SUPPORT + OTHER FIXES
notes.content:
A new update just dropped for They Bleed Pixels sorting out some issues that have come up over the years as new hardware has been released and operating systems have updated. 

Here are the highlights:

ːtbphappyː macOS Catalina support!
For those who don't know, the latest macOS version cut off support for 32-bit games and apps, including They Bleed Pixels. This update brings us up to 64-bit making it compatible with Catalina and future macOS updates.

ːtbphappyː Fixes for issues caused by Windows 10 and newer hardware!
A small number of players have run into issues with They Bleed Pixels not loading on newer hardware in Windows 10. This update should handle those special cases. Give us a shout if it doesn't!

ːtbphappyː Improved Gamepad support
This includes a number of things. Support for hot swapping. New button images and detection for Dual Shock, Xbox One and Switch Pro controllers and a fix for the bug that caused sticky inputs when playing on keyboard with a gamepad plugged in. We strongly recommend not using any of Steam's built in gamepad support when playing the game. The game does a much better job providing correct button prompts etc.. 

For a full breakdown of all the changes check this post from Ethan Lee who provided the update:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/211260/discussions/0/2148720889355958561/

We also have a new Spooky Squid Games Discord if you want to hang out, trade tips for any of our games or show off your speed running skills! 

This update was made possible thanks to our Nintendo Switch release which came out today!

You can pick it up right now with a 20% launch discount till Halloween!

notes.title: They Bleed Pixels gets new levels in free Crimson Update
notes.content:
There are over 21,000 articles on PCGamer.com—I counted—and somehow not one of them is about They Bleed Pixels. That seems like a mistake, and one I will now attempt to rectify.They Bleed Pixels is a hardcore combat-platformer. It's slower then, say, Super Meat Boy, but bolsters the extreme platforming challenge with a deep combat system that utilises combos and environmental traps. It's neat, but also absurdly difficult. And now, two years after its release, it's received a free update that adds new levels and an optional "novice" difficulty mode.This live-action trailer should give you some idea of the tone and features of the Crimson Update.Here's what's been added:
New engine rewritten in C for 60fps gameplay on netbooks and older computers. Shorter and easier Novice Difficulty levels. New bonus levels! Winter   s End and exp. 666. Record, play and share your best runs on the leaderboards. Watch the top players to improve your runs! Enhanced blood effects! Double the blood particles! Support for both DirectInput and XInput controllers. Lots of other little bits of polish, from save games to graphics options.They Bleed Pixels is also now available for Mac and Linux. To celebrate the update, the game is 75% off until June 10. That makes it a ridiculously cheap   1.74/$2.49.

 Record, play and share your best runs on the leaderboards. Watch the top players to improve your runs!
 Enhanced blood effects! Double the blood particles!
 Support for both DirectInput and XInput controllers. 
 Lots of other little bits of polish, from save games to graphics options.

ːtbpbookː While the Crimson Update is free for everyone, its existence came at a terrible cost, documented in our new live action trailer, a collaboration with photographer Paul Hillier.

notes.title: They Bleed Pixels Product Update
notes.content:
PATCH/UPDATE NOTES:

* New level, "All Hallows' Eve" added to bonus levels.
* Restart level option added to the pause menu. 
* Checkpoint files now accurately track stats when you save and continue mid-level.
* Continuing a level midway no longer replays the intro cutscene for that stage.
* More graphic tweaking options: v-sync and separate toggles for parallax and full screen effects.
